The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why now

The Health Institute runs education programs, practitioner scheduling and participant records, each with its own registration, content and payment systems as the organization grows its reach.

Even where each program's own systems look tidy on paper, Vorro's job is making sure every one of them agrees on the same participant record.

The payoff is concrete: one integration layer retires the redundant interfaces and manual data movement that quietly drain the budget, streamlining operations and taking roughly 35% out of what a health education organization The Health Institute's size spends on technology.
